_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY — this is the reference implementation's niche (a wedding-aesthetic product). Copy to niche.<yourProjectName>.json and replace every value. The loader prefers niche.<projectName>.json and falls back to this file.
product: VeilBoard — AI wedding-aesthetic generator. 60-second visual quiz returns a pack of six Pinterest-pinnable artifacts (moodboard, palette, floral, decor, invitation, style-summary card). One-time $19 / $39.
audience: Engaged person 22-38, heavy Pinterest wedding planner.
_comment_seeds: Head terms to expand via the DataForSEO suggestions + ideas endpoints. Keep broad; expansion finds the long tail.
_comment_expandSeeds: Subset of seeds to actually expand via the API (cost control). The rest still enter the pool as raw candidates.
_comment_patterns: Synthetic modifier-stacking per the playbook (Appendix A). Each {m} is filled from the named modifier set; candidates are validated against real search volume during enrichment.
_comment_modifierSets: Drawn from docs/content-engine/style-taxonomy.md so the discovered keywords map onto aesthetics the product can actually generate.
_comment_jtbd: Jobs-to-be-done queries the quiz/pack answers directly. These are the highest-fit BOFU for a generator product even when DataForSEO labels them 'informational'.
